key_points.text: Ric Elias is the CEO and co-founder of Red Ventures, which has a portfolio of fast-growing digital businesses like Lonely Planet, The Points Guy.
He began the business in 2000 and has grown it to now a global company with thousands of employees.
Ric walks us through the early struggles that have led to what is now a flourishing investing platform.
